release_notes: Ghostly has a new look: the whole app was redesigned to match the website and the desktop app. Holding a single location no longer shows "has not confirmed a location update for over 45 seconds" while everything is working, and a real drop is now noticed within seconds. If you skipped pairing on your computer, setup shows how to finish it there and continues on its own. A short connection problem while renewing free time no longer shows the upgrade screen. You can manage your subscription from Settings, and Ghostly asks about error reports only after an error happens.
